fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingBrands.cy.js#CategoryPages - CategoryListingBrands [tataBrand] [en] — Tata Trucks TC-TBR-04: listing heading, filters and cards on Tata Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TBR-04
**Title:** listing heading, filters and cards on Tata Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Tata Trucks and confirm the page heading and at least one listing card CTA. Filter By is checked when that row is present.

**Expected Result:**
Page heading is visible and at least one listing card button is shown.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Tata Trucks page
2. Verify the page heading
3. Verify listing cards (and Filter By when present)
